equations.label: Kwak 2018 Eq. (4) D-cell energy efficiency versus discharge time
equations.quote: the energy efficiency of the D cell is given below
equations.description: Logarithmic fit of available-energy ratio of the D cell (Li-polymer) to discharge time, from Fig. 6 test data.
assumptions: room-temperature test data for the D cell
validity: fit to D-cell data of Fig. 6; t_d range of the fit is not restated in the text

equations.label: Kwak 2018 Eq. (3) current rate
equations.quote: the energy discharge rate of the battery cell
equations.description: Current rate as a function of discharge time.

equations.label: Kwak 2018 Eq. (1) Seider-Tate correlation as used for PMSM cooling
equations.quote: correlation [37] is used for the calculation
equations.description: Forced convection in turbulent pipe flow for motor cooling channels, attributed by the authors to the Seider-Tate correlation [37].
equations.extraction_note: Coefficient printed as 0.023 with Pr^(1/3); recorded as stated, without judging against the original Sieder-Tate paper (not held).

equations.label: Kwak 2018 Eq. (2) short-pipe Nusselt correction
equations.quote: be corrected for the short pipe case
equations.description: Entrance correction for short cooling channels.

claims.subject: Kwak 2018 battery cell screening
claims.object: the D cell (Li-polymer) for its available energy versus discharge time
claims.statement: Kwak 2018 screened four commercial lithium cells (Table 2, cell-level values); the D cell (Li-polymer, 6.95 kW/kg, 198.5 Wh/kg) had the most favorable available-energy behavior and was chosen.
qualifiers: Table 2 values are cell specifications, not packs
claims.quote: The D cells had the most favorable characteristic

claims.subject: available battery energy
claims.object: shorter discharge time for all cell types
claims.statement: Available energy declines with shorter discharge time for all tested cells; the two Li-ion cells showed significant voltage drop for discharge times below 400 s.
claims.quote: The available energy clearly declines with a shorter discharge time

claims.subject: D cell available energy versus temperature
claims.statement: The D cells deliver available energy close to nominal for environmental temperatures between 274 and 314 K.
claims.quote: The D cells have an available energy that is close to nominal value
